name: RSSM direct future-loss gradient routing into observation encoder
scope: Known six-skill exploratory mechanism comparison on repeatedly used C. Not independent transfer, pure RGB, open-world, HULC validation or completion of the original guide.

data.support_stratum: No instantaneous bilateral+table-supported endpoints among inspected AB/C records; denominator unavailable, never report zero FPR.
data.input: Original4-frame dual-camera frozenDINO/visible-segmentation-assisted ROI and coarse tokens, public robot15. Depth/hidden poses/contact/labels not model arguments. The same existing cache in both arms.
data.known_contamination: All C roots previously used for development; original8 calibration roots subsequently in interaction-model development. All22 C four-request sequences also occur inAB. Old D is not a new blind test.

architecture.backbone: DINO frozen and already cached; no backbone loaded during fitting

gradient.joint: E andR receive full loss gradients
gradient.route_current_only: E receives only Lcurrent gradients; allR receives full loss gradients. KL0.8/0.2 stop-gradient targets unchanged. Do not detach whole latent or remove objective.
gradient.implementation: autograd.grad full loss wrt encoded observation tensor+allR; separate autograd.grad Lcurrent wrt encoded tensor; route selected incoming gradient through encoder once. Both arms calculate both paths.
gradient.clipping: E andR separately clipped at norm1 in both arms, after2microbatch accumulation. Explicit common change from old global norm1 prevents R/future gradient magnitude scaling the current-only E update. AdamW otherwise unchanged.
gradient.residual_coupling: Control still learns dynamics inR. Evolution ofR indirectly changes later current losses/E updates. No claim that encoder receives no influence of dynamics whatsoever. Pre-mask global clipping was rejected because it would also transmit future-loss magnitude directly into E scaling.

training.initialization: fresh paired random initial weights per seed; do not warmstart from future-trained checkpoints
training.data_order: Original batch_indices using independent numpy.default_rng(seed), materialized6000x2x8 and shared acrossarms
training.latent_randomness: Saved seed per microbatch seed261019000+seed*20000+update_index*2+microbatch. Reset CUDA/CPU torch RNG before forward, identical arms; draws/results can differ as probabilities diverge. Original multinomial sampler unchanged.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: original1000 linear warmup then cosine to0.00003

training.precision: original BF16autocast and float32 master parameters; deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS workspace4096:8; high float32matmul precision shared
training.checkpoint: final6000 only; progress checkpoints1000..6000 for recovery only, noCselection
training.normalization: Copy original train-only core normalization, verify60trainroots; noCfit

linear_probe.scope: Known-label accessibility of frozenE, not unseen-relation transfer
linear_probe.input: 512D encode output, each arm train-only per-channel normalization stdfloor0.0001
linear_probe.head: single Linear512->32 for original3x8 object classes,drawer3,slider3,lights2
linear_probe.seeds: same associated main seed;paired initialization seed261019600+seed
linear_probe.sampling: uniform train root then uniform of its15boundaryrecords; materialize one shared schedule perseed
linear_probe.loss: original masked symbol_nll with same train-only classweights; all valid original labels; no extra or future labels

evaluation.primary: C20 root-macro mean unweighted categoricalNLL over3objects+drawer atfree3; paired joint-minus-control delta perseed. FrozenE probe same4field currentNLL checks shared information. Report all other fields separately.
evaluation.randomness: fixed seed81831 at start of each arm/seed evaluation; common random draws for correct/wrong action; save predictions once
evaluation.interpretation: Intervals and bothseed consistency; no perfection gate. Improvement in rollout alone is not sufficient evidence that E information improved. No unique attribution to semantic-free interaction or causal effects.
evaluation.train_dev_gap: Same saved model/probe evaluated onAB and seenC; root-weightedgap, not independent transfer. Scaling and heldoutcomposition designs are report-only; no extra fits.

collapse.claim_limit: Nonzero variance or KL near the1nat freefloor alone does not rule out collapse.
